title: Boot UI: the setup title uses the real per-skin display font
description: SetupView's stage title ("Installing Sikarugir..." etc.) used plain system Text instead of SkinTitleText, so skins with a strong typographic identity (Terminal's monospace, Brutalist's display face) didn't show it on the very first screen a new user sees.
commit_message: Use SkinTitleText for the boot screen's title
author: session:5419c3
